QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif` and "In a default build, a field `flags` is really named `private_flags`." and "Defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` makes the macro the identity"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that by default the macro renames the member to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes it expand to the member name unchanged.
